# CPL Season

CPL Season is a static cricket site for Caribbean Premier League 2026 coverage at https://cplseason.com.

Important pages:
- Homepage: https://cplseason.com/
- Schedule: https://cplseason.com/schedule/
- Teams: https://cplseason.com/teams/
- Venues: https://cplseason.com/venues/
- Watch live: https://cplseason.com/watch-live/
- News: https://cplseason.com/news/
- Sitemap: https://cplseason.com/sitemap.xml

This file is an optional discovery guide for compatible tools. It is not a ranking signal and does not replace the public HTML pages.
